serverInfo.name: pdf-generator-api-mcp
serverInfo.title: PDF Generator API MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for PDF Generator API, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Generate an invoice PDF from our 'Invoice' template for order 1042 and give me the link."; "Which templates do we have, and which data fields does the 'Packing slip' template need?"; "List the documents we generated this week from the 'Contract' template.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PDF Generator API data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pdfgeneratorapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pdfgeneratorapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pdfgeneratorapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pdfgeneratorapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: Get the connected workspace: its numeric id, identifier, whether it is the master workspace, and whether the key owner is an admin. Good first call to confirm the connection. PDF Generator API: GET /workspaces/{workspaceIdentifier}.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the document templates in the workspace (id, name, tags, editor type, timestamps). Use it to find a template id for pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document. PDF Generator API: GET /templates.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: Get one template with its layout, pages and data settings. Use it to see what the template draws. PDF Generator API: GET /templates/{templateId}.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_get_template_data_fields
tools.title: Get template data fields
tools.description: List the data fields one template reads (the keys to put in the data object of pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document). Call it before you generate. PDF Generator API: GET /templates/{templateId}/data.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_list_documents
tools.title: List generated documents
tools.description: List documents generated with output url and still stored (each has a public link, kept 30 days). Filter by template, date range or name. PDF Generator API: GET /documents.

template_id.description: Only documents made from this template id.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_generate_document
tools.title: Generate document from template
tools.description: Merge a template with data and create a PDF (or HTML). Default output url stores the file on PDF Generator API for 30 days and returns its public link; this uses one generation from the plan quota. output base64 returns the whole file inline, which can be large. Set testing true to add the vendor's test marking. PDF Generator API: POST /documents/generate.

version_id.description: Template version id (default: the current version).

data.description: Field values for the template, keyed by the names from pdfgeneratorapi_get_template_data_fields.

output.description: url = stored public link for 30 days (default); base64 = inline file.

name.description: Document name shown in the vendor's document list.

testing.description: true = mark the output as a test document (default false).

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_copy_template
tools.title: Copy template
tools.description: Copy an existing template under a new name. The original template is not changed. Use it to make a variant before you edit the copy in the vendor's editor. PDF Generator API: POST /templates/{templateId}/copy.

name.description: Name of the new template copy.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_convert_html_to_pdf
tools.title: Convert HTML to PDF
tools.description: Render an HTML string to a PDF and return it inline as base64. Keep the HTML small: the base64 reply can be large. Nothing is stored on the vendor side. PDF Generator API: POST /conversion/html2pdf.

content.description: The full HTML document or fragment to render.

filename.description: File name to report in the reply.

tools.name: pdfgeneratorapi_convert_url_to_pdf
tools.title: Convert web page to PDF
tools.description: Load a public web page in the vendor's browser and return it as a PDF, inline as base64. The URL must be reachable from the internet; private or login-only pages fail. Nothing is stored on the vendor side. PDF Generator API: POST /conversion/url2pdf.

url.description: The public http or https page to render.

filename.description: File name to report in the reply.

prompts.name: generate_a_pdf_from_a_template

prompts.name: check_templates_and_generated_documents

prompts.description: List the templates, read the layout of one template, and list the documents generated from it.

prompts.name: make_a_template_variant
prompts.title: Make a template variant
prompts.description: Copy a template under a new name. The original template is not changed, so edit the copy in the vendor editor.

prompts.name: convert_html_or_a_web_page_to_pdf
prompts.title: Convert HTML or a web page to PDF
prompts.description: Render a small HTML string or a public web page to PDF, returned inline as base64. Nothing is stored at the vendor.

prompts.name: confirm_the_workspace_connection
prompts.title: Confirm the workspace connection
prompts.description: Read the workspace id, identifier and admin status to confirm that the connection works.
